speaker: Cid
narration: Oh wait... I don't think you can understand a word I'm saying. ...Do you understand me NOW?

speaker: Cid
narration: Ha! I knew it — you're a traveler from far away. Here, take this — it's called the Translator.

speaker: Cid
narration: Wear it, and you'll start to understand our {world|世界|せかい} — one {word|言葉|ことば} at a time. It grows as YOU grow.

speaker: Cid
narration: My {name|名前|なまえ} is Cid! I {help|助ける|たすける} newcomers find their {way|道|みち}.

speaker: Cid
narration: Welcome to a {world|世界|せかい} alive with wonder! Every {mountain|山|やま} touches the {sky|空|そら}, and every {forest|森|もり} hums with {secret|秘密|ひみつ} life.

speaker: Cid
narration: And in this {world|世界|せかい} — creatures! {Big|大きい|おおきい} ones that tower over treetops, {small|小さい|ちいさい} ones that nap in {flower|花|はな} petals.

speaker: Cid
narration: Here, creatures aren't pets — they're partners. Every {person|人|ひと} has a creature by their side. They {protect|守る|まもる} each other. A creature is a {friend|友達|ともだち}.

speaker: Cid
narration: But lately... a {mysterious|不思議|ふしぎ} disruption is spreading. Creatures that were once {gentle|優しい|やさしい} have become confused and wild.

speaker: Cid
narration: We don't hurt them — we calm them. Be {gentle|優しい|やさしい} enough, and they might just decide to join you!

speaker: Cid
narration: Every creature knows special moves, and every move has a {name|名前|なまえ}. The more you {learn|覚える|おぼえる}, the {strong|強い|つよい}er your team becomes!

speaker: Cid
narration: There's a whole {world|世界|せかい} waiting — deep {forest|森|もり}, rushing {water|水|みず}, roaring {fire|火|ひ}. Every {place|場所|ばしょ} teaches you something {new|新しい|あたらしい}.

speaker: Cid
narration: Along the {road|道|みち}, you'll find {food|食べ物|たべもの} to heal your team and rare ingredients to {make|作る|つくる} something amazing.

speaker: Cid
narration: And when you need a break — you'll build your own {town|町|まち}! Start {small|小さい|ちいさい}, grow it {big|大きい|おおきい}.

speaker: Cid
narration: {Talk|話す|はなす} to every {person|人|ひと} you meet. This {world|世界|せかい} runs on {heart|心|こころ} — the bond between you and everyone around you.

speaker: Cid
narration: Right now the Translator is doing the heavy lifting — readings, meanings, everything. But someday? You'll just... {understand|分かる|わかる}.

speaker: Cid
narration: That {day|日|ひ} will {come|来る|くる} sooner than you think. Now {go|行く|いく}! Your {adventure|冒険|ぼうけん} starts here — and your first {friend|友達|ともだち} is right beside you.

speaker: Cid
narration: Every adventurer needs a companion. Choose yours wisely.
